title: Pixel 11 vs Pixel 10: Should I Upgrade?
metaDescription: Pixel 11 or Pixel 10? Compare chip, camera, charging and price, plus trade-in values and Android 17 features, with advice by Pixel generation you own.
excerpt: The Pixel 11 changes less than its price suggests. Here is what is actually new, what the Pixel 10 still does, and which owners should upgrade.
answer: Upgrading from the Pixel 10 to the Pixel 11 is not worth it for most owners, according to Android Central and Digital Trends. The Pixel 11 adds the Tensor G6, a bigger main sensor, 25W wireless charging and more base storage, but the Pixel 10 is available for around $599.99 on a deals page. The best case to upgrade is for Pixel 8 and 8 Pro owners, and for Pixel 9 owners who want the new camera hardware.

sections.heading: TL;DR
sections.body:
Overall, don't upgrade to the Pixel 11 from the Pixel 10 according to sources. There isn't much reason to upgrade to the Pixel 11 according to Android Central. The Pixel 10 is a great flagship and not worth upgrading from according to Digital Trends.

The Pixel 11 does have improvements, such as a Tensor G6, more storage starting at 256GB, bigger main camera sensor, increased zoom, and faster wireless charging to 25W. However, the Pro models only have a new 50MP main camera and brighter display. The designs are very similar, batteries are around the same size and the Pixel 10 is cheaper.

If you have an older phone then upgrading is the best reason according to Digital Trends. If you have a Pixel 8 it is best to upgrade, especially if you have a Pixel 8 Pro. If you have a Pixel 9 then you could benefit from upgrading to the Pixel 11 according to Android Central. Mainly to get the third camera lens.

We've broken down the differences between the two models, improvements from Android 17 on older Pixels, price and trade-in info, and who should upgrade. We haven't tested these phones ourselves. All information comes from the sources below.

sections.heading: Price
sections.body:
The Pixel 11 starts from $899 with 256GB. Digital Trends says the Pixel 10 started at $799 for the 128GB model, meaning the starting price is $100 higher, but at 256GB both cost $899. However, the base model only increased in price due to the increased base storage according to Android Central.

The Pro models are priced the same as the 256GB Pixel 10 Pro according to Digital Trends, costing $1,099, while the Pro XL and the Pro Fold rose by $100. The Pro Fold costs $1,899, up from $1,799. However, according to Android Central the starting prices went up by $100.

The Pixel 10 is cheaper. The Pixel 10 is available for $599.99, down from $799.99 according to the deals section on Android Central. Prices vary between retailers. Some Pixel 10 models are better value once discounted according to Digital Trends. For example the Pixel 10 Pro XL dropped to $949 earlier this year.

Overall, the Pixel 10 is better value. Whilst the Pixel 11 is the new model, the increase in storage, faster charging and camera improvements may not be worth it for your region.

Check current prices before purchasing. Deals can expire and prices can change since the article was written.

sections.heading: Chip, RAM & Storage
sections.body:
The Pixel 11 has an improved Tensor G6. This has a 20% improvement in power efficiency, and 50% improvement in TPU performance compared to the Tensor G5 in the Pixel 10. According to Digital Trends Google claims a 25% improvement in web browsing speeds and 50% TPU performance boost. However, we have not done independent testing.

The Pixel 11 has 256GB and 512GB storage options whereas the Pixel 10 had 128GB and 256GB. If you have a full phone then the base model Pixel 11 has more storage.

However, the 256GB Pro models have less RAM (12GB) compared to the 16GB in the Pixel 10. Only the 512GB and 1TB have 16GB RAM. According to Android Central all the Pixel 11 models have 12GB of RAM.

The Tensor G5 should handle most of the new features so you won't feel like the Pixel 10 is old according to Android Central.

sections.heading: Camera
sections.body:
The Pixel 11 and Pixel 10 have the same triple cameras (48MP wide, 13MP ultra-wide, 10.8MP 5x telephoto). However, the Pixel 11 has a slightly larger main sensor, wider angle and up to 30x zoom. The Pixel 10 only has 20x zoom. The Pixel 11 also has Camera Looks and Magic Capture.

The new main camera is 56% more light sensitive according to Google according to Digital Trends.

The Pro models have a new main camera, redesigned 48MP telephoto, 120x Pro Zoom (up from 100x) and 5x Portrait Mode. The Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL have a new 50MP main camera. The ultra-wide and telephoto lens are unchanged according to Android Central.

The improvements in camera aren't huge if you have a Pixel 10. However, if you have a Pixel 8 or older then the improvements are bigger. If you have a Pixel 9 or older then the main reason to upgrade is for the third camera lens according to Android Central.

sections.heading: Display, Battery & Charging
sections.body:
Both phones have a 6.3 inch AMOLED display with a similar brightness. The Pixel 11 does not have LTPO. The Pro models have an increased peak brightness of 3,600 nits (up from 3,300) and have a scratch resistant coating according to Digital Trends.

Battery capacity is nearly identical, at 4,985mAh on the Pixel 11 against 4,970mAh on the Pixel 10. Digital Trends adds that the Pro batteries are slightly smaller than before, at 4,850mAh for the Pro and 5,115mAh for the Pro XL, and that the Pro Fold fell to 4,806mAh from 5,015mAh.

Wireless charging is the clearest charging change. It rises to 25W with Qi 2.2, up from 15W with Qi2. Android Central also notes that the Pixel 10 has built-in Qi2 magnets, which it lists as a reason to choose the Pixel 10. The wired charging speeds are conflicting in the text and table so we do not compare them.

The Pixel 11 Pro has been reviewed and the battery life was around 17.8 hours in a PCMark test and around 6 hours of daily screen-on time. However, we couldn't find any information on the Pixel 10. We can't say if the battery life has improved.

sections.heading: Design & Colours
sections.body:
The Pixel 11 has the same size. However, it is slightly lighter (6.9 ounces) and has a glass back instead of aluminium camera bezel. The weight is 197g compared to 204g according to Digital Trends.

The Pixel 11 has new colours (Hibiscus, Frost, Obsidian & Pistachio), whereas the Pixel 10 had Indigo, Frost, Lemongrass & Obsidian according to Android Central.

The Pro Fold has a few more changes. It is lighter (239g) compared to 258g. It is thinner when folded (10.1mm) compared to 10.8mm. The outer cover glass is made from ceramic. The hinge has been upgraded and Google says it is three times more durable.

The design is similar to the Pixel 9 and 10 series. The same sizes, horizontal camera bar and the HiLight colour LED has replaced the temperature sensor. If you want something new then this isn't the year to get a redesign according to Business Today's Pixel 11 Pro review.

sections.heading: Android 17
sections.body:
One reason not to upgrade straight away is Android 17 is not exclusive to the Pixel 11. The Next Web reports that Android 17 began rolling out to Pixel phones on June 16th, 2026, with Wear OS 7 arriving for Pixel Watches alongside it. The Pixel 10 can be upgraded to Android 17 from Android 16 according to Android Central.

The Next Web lists the features. Bubbles lets any app open as a resizable floating overlay. Screen Reactions records the selfie camera alongside a screen recording. Apps can request temporary location access that expires after one session, and you can share specific contacts instead of the whole address book. Mark as Lost in Find Hub locks a missing device with biometric authentication. Google also reduced the number of PIN guesses allowed before longer lockouts.

Foldables (such as Pixel 10 Pro Fold) have a permanent bubble bar. They also have a gaming mode for foldables. The inner screen can be split in half with a virtual gamepad. Native controller remap allows users to change the positions of buttons without needing developer support.

Gemini Intelligence is a separate rollout. The Next Web says it was due on the Galaxy S26 and the Pixel 10 line this summer, limited to hardware Google calls select advanced devices. Google has not said which capabilities arrive at launch and which later. Android 17 is a refinement release with no interface redesign.

The June Pixel Drop added new conversational editing in Google Photos for the Pixel 10 Pro, Pro XL, Pro Fold and 10a. It was only available in Germany, UK, France, Spain & Italy initially. AirDrop compatible Quick Share was also added to the Pixel 9a and 8a. The gap in software between the Pixel 10 and 11 is not as big as the hardware.

sections.heading: What the Pixel 11 has that the Pixel 10 doesn't
sections.body:
The Pixel 11 currently has exclusive features with the Creator Suite. However, Google may add features to older devices in future updates according to Digital Trends.

Android Central lists new camera features including Magic Capture, Camera Looks and Circle to Search built into the camera. Gemini Intelligence is the centerpiece and includes an agentic feature that can complete tasks on your behalf, but that feature is only available in the US.

SQ Magazine mentions the new Titan M3 security chip and six months of Google AI Pro for Pro models. The Pro line also has HiLight.

If any of these features matter to you (such as HiLight on the Pro models or Magic Capture) then it is a good reason to upgrade. However, if you are upgrading due to it being new then the evidence shows the Pixel 10 is still a solid phone.

sections.heading: Pixel 11 Pro Reviews
sections.body:
The Pixel 11 Pro has been reviewed to give you an idea of what you are paying for. It received an 8.4/10 from 91mobiles. It is a decent phone but lacks excellence. It still doesn't offer much to make you upgrade from the Pixel 10 Pro.

It scored 1,421,232 on AnTuTu, much lower than the rival flagships at 3.4 to 3.5 million. The phone runs smoothly in everyday use. Business Today also says multitasking is smooth but notes noticeable heat and a slight performance drop during long gaming sessions.

The battery life was 17.8 hours in a PCMark test. It also had around 6 hours of screen on time. This is less than the 7-8 hours we expect nowadays. Heavy users may get 15-16 hours. Neither review directly compares to the Pixel 10 Pro.

The AI features are praised. The Gemini integration stands out according to Business Today. The Rambler, Camera Coach and Magic Capture stand out according to 91mobiles. If you are upgrading for the AI features then check which ones run on your current Pixel. Some run via updates.

sections.heading: Upgrade Checklist
sections.body:
Ask yourself what is putting you off your current phone. If it is battery life, storage or an old slow chip then upgrading will help. If you are only upgrading due to it being new then save your money according to sources.

Check how old your phone is. If you have a Pixel 8 or 9 with an old battery it will be a better candidate than a one year old Pixel 10.

Check the price for the same amount of storage. The Pixel 11 base model comes with 256GB so compare to a 256GB Pixel 10.

Check trade-in deals. A discounted Pixel 10 with no trade-in may be cheaper than a Pixel 11 with a trade-in.

Consider what features you will actually use. Features like HiLight, Magic Capture, Camera Looks and the agentic Gemini feature sound nice. However, the agentic feature is only available in the USA and the HiLight feature is limited according to reviewers.

If you are upgrading second hand check the battery health and how many updates are left. The Pixel 10 will have 7 years of OS updates according to Android Central. It will be supported for a long time.

sections.heading: Trade-in Values
sections.body:
The Pixel 11 has trade-in values of $500 for a Pixel 10, $600 for the Pro and $700 for a Pro XL and up to $1,000 for the Pro Fold according to Digital Trends. This reduces the effective price of the phone.

Do the maths. A Pixel 11 at $899 with a $500 credit for a Pixel 10 works out to $399 in extra cost. Whether that is worth it depends on how much you want the extra storage, faster charging and camera improvements. We are keeping it simple and not considering tax, conditions or offer details.

Trade-in offers change frequently and have conditions.

sections.heading: Recommendations based on your phone
sections.body:
If you have a Pixel 10 or Pixel 10 Pro: The Pixel 10 isn't worth upgrading according to Digital Trends. The Pro and Pro XL models don't have much reason to upgrade. However, heavy photographers may be tempted. The Pixel 10 Pro Fold should be kept for another year.

If you have a Pixel 9: You will need a specific reason to upgrade such as the new camera hardware according to Digital Trends. If you have a Pixel 9 or older then you may find it worth upgrading for the third camera lens according to Android Central.

If you have a Pixel 8: This is the best reason to upgrade according to Digital Trends. Especially if you have a Pixel 8 Pro. However, a discounted Pixel 10 may be nearly as good.

If you are unsure ask yourself what you would notice on day one. The faster wireless charging, extra zoom and extra base storage are real improvements. However, they are small improvements. The rest are polish improvements according to reviews.

If you are buying new: The Pixel 11 is a good option if you can afford the increased price. However, the Pixel 10 is cheaper, has 7 years of OS updates and has built in Qi2 magnets. This makes it a good choice according to Android Central.

sections.heading: Things we couldn't confirm
sections.body:
Exact prices: The price is seen differently by Android Central and Digital Trends. Prices vary between retailers.

Battery life compared to Pixel 10: We couldn't find any like for like testing.

Creator Suite & other Pixel 11 features on older Pixels: We expect this according to Digital Trends. However, Google have not mentioned this.

Performance improvements: The numbers for the Tensor G6 are claimed by Google.

We haven't tested these phones. The comparison pages on Android Authority came up in our search but we didn't open them.

faq.q: Is the Pixel 11 worth upgrading to from the Pixel 10?
faq.a: No mostly. Both sources don't see much reason to upgrade from the Pixel 10.

faq.q: Who should upgrade to the Pixel 11?
faq.a: Pixel 8 owners, especially Pixel 8 Pro owners have the best reason according to Digital Trends. Pixel 9 or older users may benefit from the third camera lens according to Android Central.

faq.q: How much more is the Pixel 11?
faq.a: The starting price is $100 higher because the 128GB tier is gone, but at 256GB both cost $899 according to Digital Trends and Android Central.
The Pixel 10 is available for $599.99, down from $799.99 according to the deals section on Android Central. Prices vary between retailers.
Yes! The Pixel 10 can be upgraded to Android 17 from Android 16 according to Android Central. Android 17 started rolling out to Pixels on June 16th according to The Next Web.

faq.q: How much is the Pixel 10 worth trading in?
faq.a: Digital Trends lists $500 toward a Pixel 11 for a Pixel 10, with $600 for a Pro and $700 for a Pro XL.

faq.q: What is faster on the Pixel 11?
faq.a: The Pixel 11 has faster wireless charging (25W) and a faster Tensor G6 (50% more TPU compute) according to Google.
